label: early copy phase: outputting original tokens 3-4 (window 2-4), not the last outputs
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (100% of mass), in a position window early in the copy: steps outputting original token 2-4 (recall_idx 3 has 58% of mass, 4 has 26%, 2 has 12%). Almost never fires during the original phase, at the delimiter, at recall 0-1, or at recall >= 6, and is weak at the last 1-2 outputs. Within the window it fires on only about half of steps; the token identity changes how likely and how strong it is: outputting d gives 7x lift (top examples are all outputting d at recall_idx 3, e.g. p h q d ... <DEL> p h [q:1.0]), and w/c/x/s/f give about 3.5x. A d as the next output also raises it. A simple position window gets F1 about 0.63; adding the token set gives little extra, so the token dependence is graded and not captured.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: d, w, c, x, s, f; least: 2, p, j, g) and the next token to output (most: d, x, f, s, r, c; least: z, -, j, g); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=9 & t=13.
